name: Jest of the Frozen Slope
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Area: 10-ft.-radius burst

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each creature within the area of effect is pushed 5 feet. This is similar to the Bull Rush combat maneuver, but without the need for a combat maneuver check.

If you have ranks in the Acrobatics skill, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll. This represents your training in Acrobatics allowing you to take advantage of the disarray caused by the push.
